en.quote: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
en.riddle: This is the token of the covenant, which I have established
en.speaker: God

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־נֹחַ זֹאת אֽוֹת־הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר הֲקִמֹתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵין כָּל־בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ
he.speaker: אֱלֹהִים
